consequence.statement: The `--registry` flag is no longer honored; packages without fully qualified registry host names will not resolve and must be updated before the upgrade completes.

original.statement: The `--registry` CLI flag for specifying a default package registry has been removed; all packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name.

consequence.statement: The `--registry` flag for a default package registry is removed and all packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name. The upgrade guide requires updating any package without a registry host name before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Run `kubectl get pkg -o wide` and, before upgrading, update any package reference without a registry host name to a fully qualified name, e.g. `crossplane-contrib/provider-aws-s3:v1.23.0` -> `xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/provider-aws-s3:v1.23.0`.

corrected.statement: Crossplane 2.0 removes the `--registry` default package registry flag. All packages must use fully qualified names including the registry host name, and packages without one must be updated before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-430fc91e4c1d] says the `--registry` default-registry flag is removed, that all packages must use fully qualified names including the registry host name, and to "Update any packages without registry host names before upgrading". That is a required step before upgrading (migration-required). The evidence never says unqualified packages "will not resolve", so the proposed setting-ignored statement goes beyond the text. The action-required class and high severity stay the same.
